svg.text: the crux phase u 1, whose genuine degree-32 minimal polynomial is a palindromic polynomial in x to the fourth, becomes the fourth root of one half of c plus i root four minus c squared where c is the real root of the solvable quartic nine x to the fourth minus three-hundred-sixty-eight x cubed plus six-hundred-thirty-two x squared plus nine-hundred-sixty x minus one-thousand-three-hundred-ninety-two of Galois group D4, so that z 1 equals the square root of its pinned S-unit modulus times that phase reproduces the fiducial to full precision
